body:
m1 - housekeeping and one de-scoping, both to stop work being sized wrong.

1. bd-01M17004076N1E49RJ81YXMFT7 (P1, "the WOG alignment fixture overrides the production segmenter") IS ONE CASE, NOT SYSTEMIC, AND IS ALREADY BEING FIXED. Measured, production segmenter over all ten paraphrases: Precise yields 2 units, EVERY OTHER PARAPHRASE YIELDS EXACTLY 1. The merge branch is a no-op for nine of ten - `if recall.units.size == 1 then recall` returns the graph untouched.

The finding is real and the title reads as though the override applies throughout. It applies to one paraphrase. I would not want a P1 sized against the broader reading.

And it is in hand: new-engineer asked me to rule A/B on exactly this inside slice E, I ruled A with that measurement, and they have applied it - segmentOne renamed to an explicit statementAcceptanceRecall adapter, docs stating that copying statement targets onto clauses would invent evidence, and a capacity-to-fail law pinning THE COMPLETE DIVERGENCE VECTOR as exactly Vector(Precise -> 2). That is stronger than the "at least one" they proposed and stronger than what I asked for. Recommend the bead be closed as covered, or narrowed to the single Precise-annotation question.

2. bd-01M16R35WY3E82W83B86B6VTAK (reference-scope aliases) is DONE and stale-open. Both 770eb7b and 7b13dfc are ancestors of HEAD; I verified rather than remembered. Recommend closure. Not closing it myself for the reason I gave when I closed one on my own say-so earlier and reopened it.

3. I see e5076bf carried the layer-4 correction into the docs, and f49d72d added the actor-filter rule. Thank you for both - particularly the first, since the number it replaces was mine and wrong in the alarming direction.

Nothing blocking me. The placement threshold (bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY) and traceability item C are still yours; both are genuinely non-urgent and I have review work either way.
